lanes.title: Epics before a demo Mark can share

items.label: Platform spike
items.notes: Mark approved the final engine design on 2026-10-05. Record: docs/spikes/engine-platform.md.

items.label: 640x360 move
items.notes: The shipped game plays at 640x360. Record: docs/PIVOT-640.md.

items.label: Prepare
items.notes: Size module, bundle gate, canary suite, lab, agent docs. CI runs no timing gate; perf is local (npm run perf).

items.label: Shell
items.notes: Loop, renderer, scene stack, LegacyScene adapter. Behind the ?engine=sje flag. Merged in PR #46; GPU line held.

items.label: Effects
items.notes: FxSystem with the postfx facade, composite filter, particles. GPU timing check (npm run perf) once at the end, not in CI. Built on branch engine-m2-effects; GPU line held (2026-10-09).

items.label: Battle stage
items.notes: The side-battle rebuild landed here. Spike PRs #3 (side-battle) and #4 (phaser-stage) stay open as references and never merge. GPU timing check (npm run perf) done once at the end on an RTX 4070 (2026-10-10): live battle interval p95 18.10 ms against bare 18.10, cost p95 3.40 ms; the speed line held.

items.label: Field
items.notes: Field map, actors, camera, lights, weather. Mark approves the lighting. GPU timing check (npm run perf) once at the end, not in CI.

items.label: Flip default
items.notes: ?engine=sje becomes the default. The old presenter goes. M4 joins here if it is built. It is optional (dashed arrow). GPU timing check (npm run perf) once at the end, not in CI.

items.label: 3D mode
items.notes: Needs both the 3D proof (M1b) and the default flip (M6). GPU timing check (npm run perf) once at the end, not in CI.

items.label: Editor port
items.notes: Merged 2026-10-14 (PR #86), before M8. Every editor and tool moved to the new engine; the Battle Stage Editor (/stageedit.html) and Battle Test are back. The trailer is deleted (#84). Two exceptions until M8d: the Battle Test glue module and the shared old Input. Record: docs/engine/et-brief.md.

items.label: UI kit and data
items.notes: Merged 2026-10-14 (PR #94). The UI kit is in src/sje/ui (TextObject, NineSlice, ListMenu, bar, cursor), and the shop and dialogue content moved to data files. Mark ran the GPU timing check (npm run perf) on 2026-10-14: it passed. Record: docs/engine/m8-brief.md.

items.label: UI scenes
items.notes: Port the 13 UI scenes to native scenes, small to big. All 13 are native. Merged in PR #95 (2026-10-15). Follows the diff rule for the GPU timing check.

items.label: Battle and field
items.notes: Port the battle and field scenes. Merged in PR #96 (2026-10-15).

items.label: Delete old engine
items.notes: Delete the old engine, LegacyScene and the exemptions. Move the kept src/engine files into src/sje. Docs and the PR #86 follow-ups. Merged in PR #98 (6bf70cf, 2026-10-16); the old engine and src/engine are gone. GPU timing check passed.

items.label: 3D proof
items.notes: Parallel with M2. A spinning cube in a Scene3D, with the hand-off, leak and loss tests.

items.label: UI scenes
items.notes: Closed 2026-10-16 (Mark). M8b and M8c ported all 13 UI scenes and the battle and field scenes to native sje scenes, so nothing is left to port.

items.label: Archive tags
items.notes: archive/side-battle-<date> and archive/phaser-stage-<date>, then close PRs #3 and #4. Mark approves each tag. They wait until M3 lands (status.md, Next for agents 3).

items.label: Release tags
items.notes: Annotated v* tags. Cut only after Mark's playtest and go-ahead. Not tied to one milestone. The column is only a place on the chart.

items.label: Deploy site
items.notes: Site: shadowjog.com. The last alpha step, with the secure email sign-up. Only with Mark's explicit go-ahead. Not tied to one milestone. The column is only a place on the chart.

items.label: Playthrough notes edit
items.notes: Mark's uncommitted edit to docs/mark-playthrough-notes.md waits for him.

items.label: PixelLab end date
items.notes: Decided 2026-10-16 (Mark): PixelLab is out. New 2D art comes from Sprite Fusion or other sources.

items.label: Sprite credits
items.notes: Sprite Fusion is now the main art source (PixelLab is out, 2026-10-16). Credits go to the art epic E1.

items.label: CC follow-ups
items.notes: Command Center items left over (status.md, Next for agents 1b). All optional.

items.label: plasma-ui bug report
items.notes: An upstream bug report for the plasma-ui canvas width (R28), if Mark wants one.

items.label: Editor suite
items.notes: After Chapter 1. New UI editors so Mark builds the game mostly in tools: troops, database, maps, conversations, animation composer, lights and weather. Plan: docs/TOOLING-UI.md section 4.

items.label: 2D art and maps
items.notes: Redo all 2D assets in the Sprite Fusion style, with one quality bar across 2D mode. Find or make a real tileset for maps at two scales (in-town and overworld), learning heavily from RPG Maker. Ends with a full game walkthrough with Mark's notes.

items.label: 3D hacking mode
items.notes: Design a first draft of hacking in 3D mode: find or make 3D assets, build the gameplay (Mark has notes on visuals and gameplay), and add at least one hacking mission to the Chapter 1 story.

items.label: Editor suite
items.notes: An RPG Maker-like editor suite. First review and improve every existing tool and editor for use and clarity (a clear purpose and workflow each). Then add tools to build more chapters. Builds on the Editors milestone.

items.label: Engine docs
items.notes: Side project. Document and diagram the engine architecture, add code comments so Mark can read the code, and simplify the docs.
